On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 10:03 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Jordan — great to hear the team is ready. I reviewed the attached plan quickly, looks sensible.

Thanks — read the plan. A few notes from the SE side:
- If you run a mixed workload with ~1k req/s and ~90% short (~30–50 tokens) + ~10% long (~400–700 tokens) you should expect higher token burn than a uniform short prompt profile.
- For a 48h window at 1k rps the rough token range we estimate is 1.2–2.2M tokens depending on response sizes and retry rates.

Options we recommend:
1) One-time top-up: 2,000,000 tokens applied to your trial account to cover the weekend soak.
2) Temporary daily uplift: increase daily quota by 50k tokens/day for 14 days (useful if you plan follow-up runs).

I've attached a short Redwood_SLA_FAQ.pdf that covers how we handle burst windows and fallback behavior. If you confirm model and sample distribution we can pick 1) or 2) and I'll author the request for approval.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
